notes: Lemma in -a. Written for feminine nouns (māja). Masculine declension-4 nouns (puika) are not covered: their dat.sg differs (-am, not -ai), so they report no-table until a masculine table exists; see content/_needed.json.
voc.sg is deliberately absent (a gap): the singular vocative has competing forms and is mostly out of scope (SPEC.md non-goals); see content/_needed.json.
